timeline.summary: TARC Limited informed the exchange regarding an Enforcement Directorate search at its premises pertaining to a pre-demerged entity transaction prior to 2020.
Infomerics Valuation and Rating reaffirmed TARC Limited's NCD rating at IVR BBB- with Rating Watch with Negative Implications.
Amar Sarin and PACs declared no encumbrance on 19,21,57,722 TARC shares held by them as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI regulations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹208.7 Cr (+1665.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹1.62 Cr.
TARC reported FY26 consolidated total income of ₹671.78 Cr and PAT of ₹19.03 Cr, turning from an FY25 loss as revenue recognition began at TARC Tripundra.
TARC Limited reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹329.84 Cr and PAT of ₹19.03 Cr, driven by the commencement of revenue recognition at TARC Tripundra.
